purpose: Four-variant feasibility and published-mechanism consistency check; not an independent accuracy benchmark
gene_universe: Genes with an annotated TSS within the fixed 1048576-bp variant-centered interval, intersected with genes returned by the model
ranking: Descending median absolute RNA_SEQ raw score across tracks for the primary ontology; tie-break by Ensembl gene ID
direction: Sign of the median signed RNA_SEQ raw score in the primary ontology; score exactly zero is inconclusive
baseline: Nearest annotated TSS among the same evaluable gene universe; report full-reference nearest TSS separately
supporting_scores: RNA_SEQ_ACTIVE is descriptive expression context; SPLICE_SITES is a nonsigned molecular score, not intron-retention direction
known_coverage_limits: No RNA-seq metadata track explicitly identified as IL-4-stimulated macrophages
Generic immune-cell tracks do not establish coverage of PSC-specific CCR9 subsets
Metadata do not establish that the same stimulation state, donor cohort, or assay matches the published eQTL study
limitations: Known gene examples selected from prior literature; no novelty claim
ALL_FOLDS predictions are not a held-out genomic test
No matched negative-control set or calibrated hypothesis test in this first pilot
Only two variants have source-supported directional comparisons
No minimum expression or effect threshold is selected after inspecting scores; small effects remain descriptive
Risk alleles are not transferred between correlated variants without phase evidence
